author: The Current
description:
Watch Nur-D and his full band perform "Purple in the Sky" live onstage
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube

On Friday, April 3, Nur-D lit up the stage at the Amsterdam Bar + Hall in St. Paul with a full-band set of his energetic and innovative brand of hip-hop, including the song "Purple in the Sky," above. 

The set was part of The Current Presents Minnesota Music Month featuring: NUR-D, runo plum, and Agnes Uncaged with Special Appearances by jeremy messersmith, Singing Resistance Twin Cities, and the High School for Recording Arts Students.

Watch Nur-D’s full set here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=okf1IZECKPk 

Musicians
Nur-D – vocals
DJ Hayes – DJ
Saxy Dave – saxophone
Tuvok the Word – drums
Brotha Ivory – keyboard
Mr. Pants – saxophone
Highstylekyle – trumpet
El Parcero – bass guitar
Alice Daytona – guitar
